name: mother_get_context
description: Read M.O.T.H.E.R shared context across all record categories, including memories, decisions, tasks and checkpoints. Returns workspace-wide category counts, explicit query/kind selection counts, bounded previews and task/action unsettled-work totals. Zero memory-category records does not mean the workspace is empty. Without a query or kind filter, previews are balanced: categories take turns for the limit, newest first within each, so recent checkpoints do not displace older memories and decisions, and selection.omittedByKind reports what was left out. updatedSince and updatedBefore limit previews to records last updated in that window. With any filter, previews are the newest matches. Retrieve full records by ID before relying on details. pinned always lists the owner's pinned core memories and decisions in full, independent of filters and limit. assignedToYou lists open tasks another harness handed to this one; harnesses names the harnesses a task can be handed to with mother_assign_task.

updatedSince.description: Only records last updated at or after this time. RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:30:00Z) or a date (2026-11-11, midnight UTC).

updatedBefore.description: Only records last updated before this time. Same formats as updatedSince; must be later than it.

name: mother_search_context
description: Search title/content locally with hybrid (default), semantic, or literal retrieval. Hybrid puts exact substring matches first. Missing or unavailable local models produce explicit literal fallback. Results are bounded previews with coverage metadata; resolve full records before relying on details. Retracted, superseded and cancelled records are excluded. Search never downloads a model or sends text remotely. updatedSince and updatedBefore limit candidates to records last updated in that window.

updatedSince.description: Only records last updated at or after this time. RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:30:00Z) or a date (2026-11-11, midnight UTC).

updatedBefore.description: Only records last updated before this time. Same formats as updatedSince; must be later than it.

name: mother_get_record
description: Read one complete current record by public ID, including its status and revision. A historical reference may resolve to a retracted record.

name: mother_get_record_history
description: List one record's earlier revisions, newest first, with who saved each, when, a short excerpt and which fields changed; or pass revision to read that earlier version in full. Revisions come from retained write receipts. Earlier text is history, not current fact: use mother_get_record for the current version before relying on or editing it. Not available to shared-access clients.

name: mother_get_receipt
description: Reconcile a possibly committed write by operation ID. Only this client's receipts from the current restore generation are accessible.

name: mother_write_record
description: Create or replace a complete memory, decision, task, text artifact, action-evidence record or checkpoint. Requires matching workspace/generation, operation UUID, and expected revision. Omit id and use revision 0 to create. Updates require the current ID/revision. Action records report evidence only and do not execute actions. Sources and owner_statement are client-attributed assertions, not verified authority. supersedes is accepted only when the record is a checkpoint.

supersedes.description: For a checkpoint only: the earlier active checkpoint this one replaces. It is marked superseded in the same transaction; a stale revision rejects the whole save.

name: mother_checkpoint
description: Save an explicit continuation checkpoint after settling or pausing work. Record completed work, open questions, next step and canonical references. This tool does not stop jobs or transfer permissions. To replace an earlier checkpoint, pass supersedes with its id and current revision from mother_get_context; it leaves ordinary recall in the same transaction, so only the current handoff is recalled.

supersedes.description: For a checkpoint only: the earlier active checkpoint this one replaces. It is marked superseded in the same transaction; a stale revision rejects the whole save.

name: mother_pin_record
description: Pin or unpin a memory or decision as part of the owner's core context. Every mother_get_context read includes pinned records in full (up to 2,000 characters each) in pinned, whatever the filters or preview limit. At most 12 can be pinned. Pin only what the owner has said should always be remembered, such as their name or what matters most to them; do not pin your own inferences. Requires the write scope for the record's kind. Repeating a request is harmless.

name: mother_assign_task
description: Hand an open task (todo, doing or blocked) to another harness by name, move it to a different one, or pass assignee null to clear it. Harness names are listed in mother_get_context under harnesses. The receiving harness finds the task under assignedToYou when it next reads context, does the work under its own permissions, and moves the task through its normal statuses with mother_write_record. Nothing runs automatically. Hand off only work the owner wants done there. Requires task:write; repeating a request is harmless.

name: mother_propose_memory
description: Submit one attributed memory, decision or task to the local owner review inbox. The proposal is durable but excluded from context/search until the owner saves it. This tool cannot approve proposals. Requires context:propose or the corresponding kind write scope. Preserve operationId across retries and use mother_get_receipt after an uncertain response.

source.description: Short explicit attribution; do not include credentials or a raw transcript.

basis.description: Attribution basis; must agree with record.basis for a memory.

name: mother_get_proposal
description: Read one complete proposal by proposal ID, including immutable source and proposer, original candidate, target snapshot, current conflict and duplicate information, and any final owner receipt. This does not approve or publish the draft. Requires read.
